Bill.BriefDescription: Including goats in theft of livestock in the first degree.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to theft of livestock; amending RCW 9A.56.080 and4.24.320; and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 9A.56.080 and 2003 c 53 s 74 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Every person who, with intent to sell or exchange and todeprive or defraud the lawful owner thereof, willfully takes, leads, ortransports away, conceals, withholds, slaughters, or otherwiseappropriates any horse, mule, cow, heifer, bull, steer, swine, goat, orsheep is guilty of theft of livestock in the first degree. (2) Theft of livestock in the first degree is a class B felony.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 4.24.320 and 2003 c 53 s 4 are each amended to read asfollows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: ((Any person who suffers damages as a result of actions describedin RCW 9A.48.080(c) or)) Any owner of a horse, mule, cow, heifer, bull,steer, swine, goat, or sheep who suffers damages as a result of awillful, unauthorized act described in RCW 9A.56.080 or 9A.56.083 may p. 1 SHB 1398bring an action against the person or persons committing the act in acourt of competent jurisdiction for exemplary damages up to three timesthe actual damages sustained, plus attorney's fees.
